descriptions.description: Medicago minima is a plant species of the genus Medicago. It is native to the Mediterranean basin but is found worldwide.Jepson Manual Treatment It forms a symbiotic relationship with the bacterium Sinorhizobium meliloti, which is capable of nitrogen fixation. Common names include bur medick, little bur-clover, little bur medick, little medick, small medick, and woolly bur medick.
